data.one_liner: Patterns and APIs to implement advanced search features with Algolia for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides patterns and APIs to customize search experiences at a deeper level for Flutter. It manages common search logic, states, multi-index searches, filters, and facets handling.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that uses Algolia for search.
You need advanced search features like multi-index search, disjunctive faceting, and custom filter states.
avoid_when: You do not use Algolia as your search backend.
You only need simple, direct REST API calls without search-specific helpers.
strengths: Simplifies complex Algolia search states and interactions.
Supports multi-index search and facet value handling out of the box.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Algolia service ecosystem.
Not documented with broad platform integration details beyond basic features.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making custom raw HTTP requests to a search API instead of using the dedicated Algolia helper package.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight built-in HTTP client for custom search endpoint communication without extra Algolia abstractions.
